projectDescription: Formal opposition record to Certificate of Appropriateness applications HP2026-0244 and HP2026-0248 for 1505 Tulane Street, documenting boundary disputes, code violations, and design guideline deficiencies before the Houston Archaeological and Historical Commission.
keyFeatures: Boundary dispute with fluctuating southern property line (3–5 ft shift)
Unapproved lot combination — no recorded Replat or Agreement to Bind Properties
Cumulative side setback violation (12 ft shown vs. 15 ft required for two-story)
Per-lot FAR violations when lots evaluated independently
Attached garage misclassified as detached — 528 sq ft FAR exemption invalid
Driveway retention violation under Houston Heights Design Guidelines
Context area misrepresentation — camelbacks labeled as full two-story
Multiple building code, fire code, and life safety violations
Street survey pin evidence corroborating historic retaining wall boundary
Texas adverse possession and boundary-by-acquiescence legal claims
Internal inconsistencies and arithmetic errors in COA submittals
